content.text: Health Canada's guidance is to start solids around 6 months. Theo is 5 months, so you've got about a month. In the meantime, watch for readiness signs: he sits with support, holds his head steady, reaches for your food, and has lost the reflex that pushes food out with his tongue. Until then, breast milk or formula is all he needs. When you do start, iron-rich foods like meat, fish, eggs or iron-fortified cereal come first. Confirm timing with your provider or local public health.
